title: The Paddle Shack

services.name: Paddleboard rental
services.desc: The Paddle Shack is your go-to for an unforgettable day on the water! Rent a kayak for a peaceful paddle, hop on a paddleboard for an adventure, or book a guided boat tour to explore hidden gems along the coast. However you choose to ride the waves, we have everything you need for a day of fun. Set sail on the Big Fripper, our BRAND NEW 47' excursion catamaran, built by Ron Cooper Catamarans and powered by twin 300 Suzukis. Designed for comfort and adventure, this spacious vessel is complete with a bar and stunning sunset views. This is the perfect choice for private rentals or a relaxing evening on the water. The Big Fripper offers the chance to unwind and watch dolphins play in the waves.

services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Fripp Island is a prime destination for fishing enthusiasts of all levels. With opportunities year-round, each season offers unique experiences for a great catch. Wardle’s Landing is a fishing pier on the island, offering beautiful marsh views and a great spot to cast a line (learn more about Wardle's Landing here). Don't miss out on the island's exciting fishing tournaments throughout the year. Check out our different fishing tournaments below: In May, we host the Memorial Day Fishing Tournament.
